ei.title: 실험실 내의 통제 변수를 실생활에 적용하기
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to (A)[control / release] the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to (B)[apply / ignore] what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that (C)[benefits / harms] humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 과학자는 실험실 내 변수 값을 '통제(control)'한다. 심리학자는 배운 것을 실세계 문제 행동 교정에 '적용(apply)'한다. 독립 변수를 조작해 인간에게 '도움이 되는(benefits)' 방식으로 세상을 바꾼다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① control — apply — benefits: 원문 일치
❌ ② release(풀어주다)는 원문 control(통제하다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다)는 원문 apply(적용하다)와 의미 불일치
❌ ④ harms(해를 끼치다)는 원문 benefits(이롭게 하다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: control(통제하다), apply(적용하다), benefit(이롭게 하다)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has (A)[practical / theoretical] value when scientists can isolate (B)[independent / dependent] variables and then manipulate them to change (C)[important / trivial] parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 과학은 '실질적(practical)' 가치를 갖는다. 과학자가 '독립(independent)' 변수를 분리한다. 세상의 '중요한(important)' 부분을 변화시킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① dependent(종속의)는 원문 independent(독립의)의 반의어
✅ ② practical — independent — important: 원문 일치
❌ ③ theoretical(이론적인)은 원문 practical(실질적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ trivial(사소한)은 원문 important(중요한)의 반의어
det.tip: practical(실질적인), independent variable(독립 변수), important(중요한)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have (A)[successfully / unsuccessfully] applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. (B)[intensive / minimal] interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, (C)[enable / prevent] many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 심리학자들이 '성공적으로(successfully)' 효과의 법칙을 자폐아 치료에 적용해 왔다. '집중적인(intensive)' 개입은 많은 아이들이 정상적인 삶을 살 수 있게 '한다(enable)'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① unsuccessfully(성공하지 못하게)는 원문 successfully의 반의어
❌ ② minimal(최소한의)은 원문 intensive(집중적인)의 반의어
✅ ③ successfully — intensive — enable: 원문 일치
❌ ④ prevent(막다)는 원문 enable(~할 수 있게 하다)의 반의어
det.tip: successfully(성공적으로), intensive(집중적인), enable(~할 수 있게 하다)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to ①<u>control</u> the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to ②<u>apply</u> what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can ③<u>combine</u> independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that ④<u>benefits</u> humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 isolate(분리하다)인데 combine(결합하다)로 바꿈. 과학은 독립 변수를 '분리한 다음' 조작하여 세상을 변화시킨다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① control(통제하다): 실험실 내 변수 값을 통제한다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② apply(적용하다): 실험실에서 배운 것을 현실 세계에 적용한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ combine(결합하다) → isolate(분리하다): 과학자는 독립 변수를 '분리해' 낸 뒤 조작해야 하므로 combine은 정반대 의미
✅ ④ benefits(이롭게 하다): 인간이나 세상에 도움을 주는 방식이라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: isolate(분리하다) ↔ combine(결합하다)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes ①<u>possible</u>. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to ②<u>worsen</u> problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then ③<u>manipulate</u> them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have ④<u>successfully</u> applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 correct(교정하다)인데 worsen(악화시키다)로 바꿈. 심리학자가 문제 행동을 '교정하려' 시도한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① possible(가능한): 실험실 밖 변수 통제가 '가능해진다'는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② worsen(악화시키다) → correct(교정하다): 실험실에서 배운 것을 적용해 문제 행동을 '교정하려' 해야 하므로 worsen은 정반대
✅ ③ manipulate(조작하다): 독립 변수를 '조작해' 세상을 바꾼다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ successfully(성공적으로): 효과의 법칙을 자폐아 치료에 성공적으로 적용했다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: correct(교정하다) ↔ worsen(악화시키다)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have ①<u>learned</u> in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate ②<u>independent</u> variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the ③<u>treatment</u> of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively ④<u>miserable</u> and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 normal(정상적인)인데 miserable(비참한)로 바꿈. 집중적인 개입이 자폐아가 '비교적 정상적이고 행복한' 삶을 살 수 있게 한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① learned(배운): 실험실에서 '배운' 것을 현실에 적용한다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② independent(독립의): '독립' 변수를 분리하고 조작한다는 전문 용어로 적절
✅ ③ treatment(치료): 자폐아 '치료'에 효과의 법칙을 적용했다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ miserable(비참한) → normal(정상적인): happy lives와 병렬되는 긍정적 단어가 필요하므로 miserable은 정반대
det.tip: normal(정상적인) ↔ miserable(비참한)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to __________ the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 통제하다(control). 과학자가 실험을 통해 실험실 내 변수 값을 '통제할' 수 있게 되면 실험실 밖 변수 통제도 가능해진다는 도입부 동사.
det.analysis:
✅ ① control(통제하다): 빈칸 뒤 'of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible'로 이어지는 'control of variables'의 원문 동사
❌ ② isolate(분리하다): 후반부 '독립 변수를 분리한다'는 맥락의 동사로, 도입부 '통제'와 위치 불일치
❌ ③ manipulate(조작하다): '변수를 조작한다'는 후반부 동사로, 도입부 문맥과 불일치
❌ ④ change(변화시키다): '세상을 변화시킨다'는 후반부 동사로, 도입부 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: control the value of variables = 변수 값을 통제하다 (실험 통제의 핵심 개념)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to __________ problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 교정하다(correct). 과학 심리학자가 실험실에서 배운 것을 현실 세계의 문제 행동을 '교정하는' 데 적용한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
❌ ① manipulate(조작하다): 후반부 '변수를 조작한다'의 동사로 문제 행동과의 결합이 부자연스러움
❌ ② isolate(분리하다): 독립 변수의 동사로, 문제 행동과 결합 시 의미 불일치
❌ ③ change(변화시키다): 세상을 '변화'시키는 대상의 동사로, 문제 행동에 직접 쓰면 중립적 의미
✅ ④ correct(교정하다): 'to try to correct problem behaviors'로 원문에서 '문제 행동 교정'을 정확히 지칭
det.tip: correct problem behaviors = 문제 행동을 교정하다 (임상 심리학 맥락)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive __________, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 개입(interventions). 어릴 때 시작되어 행동의 결과를 조작하는 데 중점을 둔 '집중적인 개입'이 자폐아 삶을 돕는다는 결론부.
det.analysis:
❌ ① experiments(실험): 앞 문단의 실험실 개념과 혼동 가능하지만, 자폐아 치료 현장의 중재 활동을 가리키는 단어가 아님
✅ ② interventions(개입): Intensive ________ 에 해당하는 원문 명사로, 자폐아 치료 개입 활동
❌ ③ laboratories(실험실): 장소 명사로, Intensive와 결합해 행동을 돕는 주체가 될 수 없음
❌ ④ psychologists(심리학자): 주어가 아니라 치료 수단이 필요한 자리
det.tip: intervention = 개입, 중재 (임상 심리학 용어)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to <u>apply</u> what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>apply</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: apply = use = 적용하다, 활용하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore(무시하다): apply의 반의어
✅ ② use(사용하다): apply의 동의어로 가장 적절
❌ ③ cancel(취소하다): 무관
❌ ④ invent(발명하다): 무관
det.tip: apply = use = utilize = 적용하다, 사용하다

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to <u>correct</u> problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>correct</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: correct = fix = 교정하다, 바로잡다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① fix(바로잡다): correct의 동의어로 가장 적절
❌ ② reject(거부하다): 무관
❌ ③ avoid(피하다): 무관
❌ ④ repeat(반복하다): 무관
det.tip: correct = fix = amend = 바로잡다, 교정하다

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, <u>enable</u> many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>enable</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: enable = allow = ~할 수 있게 하다, 가능하게 하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① forbid(금지하다): enable의 반의어
❌ ② refuse(거부하다): 무관
❌ ③ doubt(의심하다): 무관
✅ ④ allow(허용하다): enable의 동의어로 가장 적절
det.tip: enable = allow = make it possible = ~할 수 있게 하다

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate <u>independent</u> variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>independent</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: independent(독립의) ↔ dependent(종속의).
det.analysis:
✅ ① dependent(종속의): independent의 반의어로 가장 적절. '독립 변수' ↔ '종속 변수' 대응
❌ ② separate(분리된): independent의 유의어
❌ ③ distinct(구별되는): independent의 유의어
❌ ④ autonomous(자율적인): independent의 유의어
det.tip: independent variable(독립 변수) ↔ dependent variable(종속 변수)

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. <u>intensive</u> interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>intensive</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: intensive(집중적인, 철저한) ↔ superficial(피상적인, 겉핥기의).
det.analysis:
❌ ① thorough(철저한): intensive의 유의어
❌ ② extensive(광범위한): intensive와 대립보다는 보완 관계. 진정한 반의어는 '깊이가 얕은' 쪽
✅ ③ superficial(피상적인): intensive(깊이 집중한)의 반의어로 가장 적절
❌ ④ concentrated(집중된): intensive의 유의어
det.tip: intensive(집중적·철저한) ↔ superficial(피상적인)

questions.passage:
(A) Scientists are able to control the <u>value</u> of variables in the laboratory through experimentation. By adjusting each numerical <u>value</u>, they test how the outcome changes.

(B) Science has practical <u>value</u> when scientists can change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans. This social <u>value</u> is what makes research meaningful.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 value의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 value는 '수치(numerical value)', (B)의 value는 '가치(practical/social value)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 수치 — (B) 가치: (A)는 변수의 수치 값, (B)는 실질적 가치
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)는 '가격'이 아니라 '가치'
❌ ④ (A)는 '가치'가 아니라 '수치'
det.tip: value: 수치(측정값), 가치(중요성), 가격(price). 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to keep two things or people apart from each other"

det.korean: isolate = 분리하다, 격리하다 (둘을 서로 떨어뜨려 놓다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① manipulate(조작하다): 둘을 분리하는 의미가 아님
❌ ② apply(적용하다): 분리와 무관
✅ ③ isolate(분리하다): 두 대상을 서로 떨어뜨려 놓는다는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ④ enable(~할 수 있게 하다): 분리와 무관
det.tip: isolate = 분리하다, 격리하다 (= separate, keep apart)

questions.passage: Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on __________ (manipulate) the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

manipulate → ____

det.korean: 어릴 때 시작되어, 행동의 결과를 '조작하는' 데 크게 기반을 둔 집중적인 개입이 그런 많은 아이들이 비교적 정상적이고 행복한 삶을 살 수 있게 한다.
det.analysis: 전치사 on 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 함. based on + -ing 구조로 '~하는 데 기반을 둔'. manipulate → manipulating(동명사)로 변환.
det.tip: based on + 동명사(-ing) = ~하는 데 기반을 둔

questions.passage: For example, scientific psychologists have successfully __________ (apply) the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

apply → ____

det.korean: 예를 들어, 과학 심리학자들은 '효과의 법칙'을 자폐아 치료에 성공적으로 '적용해' 왔다.
det.analysis: 현재완료 시제 have + p.p. 구조. have successfully __________ 뒤에 과거분사가 필요. apply → applied(과거분사)로 변환. have applied = 적용해 왔다.
det.tip: have + p.p.(과거분사) = 현재완료. apply의 과거분사는 applied

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate __________ and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 독립 변수(independent variables). 과학이 실질적 가치를 가지려면 과학자가 '독립 변수'를 분리한 뒤 조작할 수 있어야 한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① problem behaviors(문제 행동): 앞 문장의 '교정 대상'으로 이미 언급되어 빈칸 자리와 불일치
❌ ② laboratory settings(실험실 환경): isolate의 목적어로 부자연스러움
❌ ③ scientific theories(과학 이론): 이론은 '분리·조작'의 대상이 아님
✅ ④ independent variables(독립 변수): isolate and manipulate의 목적어로 정확히 부합
det.tip: isolate and manipulate independent variables = 독립 변수를 분리하고 조작하다

questions.passage: Once scientists are able to control the value of variables in the laboratory through experimentation, control of variables outside the laboratory becomes possible. For scientific psychologists, this means that they are able to apply what they have learned in the laboratory to try to correct problem behaviors in the real world. Science has practical value when scientists can isolate independent variables and then manipulate them to change important parts of the world in a manner that __________ in which they live. For example, scientific psychologists have successfully applied the Law of Effect to the treatment of children with autism. Intensive interventions, begun at an early age, and based in large part on manipulating the consequences of their behavior, enable many such children to live relatively normal and happy lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인간이나 세상에 도움을 준다(benefits humans or the world). 과학자가 독립 변수를 조작해 세상을 변화시키는 '방식'을 수식하는 구절로, 과학의 실질적 가치(practical value)의 목적 선언.
det.analysis:
❌ ① control the value of variables: 도입부에 이미 등장한 '실험실 내 변수 값 통제' 구절이며, Science의 practical value를 정의하는 자리에 맞지 않음
✅ ② benefits humans or the world: 원문 'in a manner that benefits humans or the world in which they live'의 핵심 구절로 과학의 실질적 가치 = 인간·세상에 도움
❌ ③ correct problem behaviors: 심리학 응용 예시 구절로, 일반 과학의 목적 선언 자리에는 범위가 협소
❌ ④ manipulate the consequences of their behavior: 마지막 문장의 자폐아 개입 세부 설명 구절로 빈칸 자리의 일반 원칙과 불일치
det.tip: in a manner that benefits humans or the world = 인간이나 세상에 도움이 되는 방식으로 (과학의 실질적 가치)

ch: manipulate the consequences of their behavior
